description: Get an existing route with the specified route name under the specified subscription, resource group, profile, and AzureFrontDoor endpoint.

props.description: Indicates whether content compression is enabled on AzureFrontDoor. Default value is false. If compression is enabled, content will be served as compressed if user requests for a compressed version. Content won't be compressed on AzureFrontDoor when requested content is smaller than 1 byte or larger than 1 MB.
